hypothesis: If a boss is within 200 units, telling the planner to evade and not open a chest keeps that chest from becoming the goal and loses less health in the amusing minute than the 115 hp the 2:43 run lost chasing it.
test: Champion action templates, E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup. Planner directive only: until a chest or food is listed, explore; if health is under 40% and food is listed, eat it; if health is under 40% and no food is listed, evade and do not open a chest; if a boss is within 200 units, evade, and do not open a chest or charge a spot; if a chest is listed and no boss is within 200, open it. While a boss is within 200, evade should win, and a listed chest should not become the goal. Inconclusive if no boss comes within 200. A zero chest-goal count is a success only when a chest was listed in that window and was not taken. If no chest is listed while the boss is within 200, the skip is inconclusive; still record whether evade won.
outcome: Died 3:45 on XEPS03, level 10, 1222 kills, 119 damage, about 30 healed. Minute 2 lost 22 and ended 96/120. Amusing at 2:00 (182 left), 6 damage on the outcome. Colorado Queen at 3:02, no queen line. Chests opened 3, all with no boss within 200 (1:45, 1:46, 2:49). No chest was listed while a boss was within 200. Evade won at 2:00 through 2:23 and at 3:05 through 3:13, then explore won at 2:24, 2:29, 2:30, 2:35, 2:41 and 3:18 with the boss still inside 200. Minute 3 lost 97. No evolution. Seed Potato 8/8, Whisk 3/8, four weapons at 1/8, Fertilizer 2/5.
learnings: The skip was not tested: a zero chest-goal count during the boss only counts when a chest was listed, and none was. Evade did win the moment each boss became the subject of a plan (2:00 keep-away 30%, reason a boss appeared; 3:05 keep-away 45%), and it kept winning for one to three cycles. It then lost to explore while the boss was still inside 200: 2:24 explore 36% vs keep-away 27% with amusing 91 left, and the same shape at 2:29 (boss 137), 2:30 (156), 2:35 (83), 2:41 (116) and 3:18 (queen 160, explore 33% vs 31%). Minute 2's 22 hp against the 2:43 run's 115 is a different seed and came mostly after the line had already faded, so it does not confirm the directive. The death was the queen minute's pests (garden-slug 32, tomato-leech 21, sand-crab 18), and the queen's appearance did not log its own plan until the 5-second tick. A planner.goal line is the next test of the fade. The chest-during-boss case is still open.
